seo.title: 50 Portfolio Project Ideas for Solana Developers
seo.description: Build an impressive Solana portfolio with these 50 project ideas. From Anchor programs to DeFi protocols, showcase your Rust and Solana expertise.

content.intro: Solana's high-performance architecture requires a different approach than EVM chains. These projects will help you demonstrate expertise in Anchor, account models, and Solana-specific patterns.

sections.heading: Anchor Program Fundamentals
sections.description: Master the basics of Solana program development with Anchor.

items.title: Simple Escrow Program
items.description: Build an escrow program that holds tokens until conditions are met, demonstrating PDAs and token transfers.

items.title: Voting Program
items.description: Create a voting program with proposal creation, voting periods, and result tallying using Anchor.

items.title: Token Vesting Contract
items.description: Build a vesting program with cliff periods, linear unlocks, and beneficiary management.

items.title: Subscription Service
items.description: Create a recurring payment program where users subscribe and are charged periodically.

items.title: Multi-sig Wallet
items.description: Implement a multi-signature wallet requiring M-of-N approvals for transactions.

sections.heading: NFT and Token Projects
sections.description: Build NFT and token projects on Solana using Metaplex and SPL standards.

items.title: Candy Machine Custom Guard
items.description: Create a custom guard for Candy Machine v3 with unique minting conditions.

items.title: NFT Staking Program
items.description: Build a staking program for NFTs that rewards holders with SPL tokens based on time staked.

items.title: Compressed NFT Collection
items.description: Deploy a collection using cNFTs with Bubblegum for cost-effective large-scale mints.

items.title: Token Extensions Implementation
items.description: Build tokens using Token-2022 extensions like transfer hooks, fees, and confidential transfers.

items.title: NFT Rental System
items.description: Create an NFT rental program where owners can lend NFTs for a fee while retaining ownership.

sections.heading: DeFi on Solana
sections.description: Build DeFi protocols leveraging Solana's speed and low costs.

items.title: Simple AMM
items.description: Build a constant product AMM with liquidity provision, swaps, and fee collection.

items.title: Order Book DEX
items.description: Create a limit order book exchange using Serum's matching engine patterns.

items.title: Lending Pool
items.description: Build a simple lending pool with deposits, borrows, and interest accrual.

items.title: Yield Aggregator
items.description: Create a vault that auto-compounds yields from multiple Solana DeFi protocols.

items.title: Perpetual Futures Simplified
items.description: Build a simplified perpetual futures contract with funding rates and liquidations.

sections.heading: Infrastructure and Tools
sections.description: Build tooling and infrastructure for Solana development.

items.title: Anchor Testing Framework
items.description: Create a reusable testing framework for Anchor programs with common test patterns.

items.title: Transaction Builder UI
items.description: Build a visual interface for constructing and simulating Solana transactions.

items.title: Account Deserializer
items.description: Create a tool that deserializes any Anchor account given the IDL and displays readable data.

items.title: Priority Fee Calculator
items.description: Build a service that estimates optimal priority fees based on current network conditions.

items.title: Automated Program Upgrade Bot
items.description: Create a CI/CD pipeline for safely deploying and upgrading Solana programs.

sections.heading: Gaming and Social
sections.description: Build gaming and social applications leveraging Solana's speed.

items.title: On-chain Game State
items.description: Build a simple game (chess, tic-tac-toe) with game state stored entirely on-chain.

items.title: Achievement System
items.description: Create an on-chain achievement system that mints soulbound NFTs for completed challenges.

items.title: Social Feed Program
items.description: Build a decentralized social feed where posts are stored on-chain with likes and comments.

items.title: Tipping Protocol
items.description: Create a protocol for tipping content creators with SPL tokens and tracking contributions.

items.title: Prediction Game
items.description: Build a prediction game where users bet on outcomes with oracle-resolved results.

sections.heading: Infrastructure and Tooling
sections.description: Build tools that help other Solana developers.

items.title: Account Deserializer
items.description: Build a tool that deserializes Solana account data given an IDL.

items.title: Transaction Builder UI
items.description: Create a GUI for building and simulating Solana transactions.

items.title: Program Upgrade Tracker
items.description: Build a service that monitors program upgrades and alerts on changes.

items.title: Compute Budget Analyzer
items.description: Tool to analyze compute unit usage across transactions.

items.title: Multi-sig Program
items.description: Build a multi-signature program for secure team transactions.

proTips.tip: Master the account model first. Solana's programming model is fundamentally different from EVM, and accounts are the key.
Use Anchor for most projects but understand native Solana programs too. Some optimizations require going lower-level.
Test on devnet extensively. Solana's transaction limits and compute budgets catch many developers off guard.
Learn to read Solana explorer transaction logs. They tell you exactly what happened when things go wrong.
Join the Anchor Discord and follow Solana developers on Twitter. The ecosystem moves fast and knowledge is shared publicly.
